verdict.rationale: Insomnia covers the GitOps-adjacent parts of the story. Git Sync keeps project data (specs, collections, environments) in your own Git repository, and the Inso CLI runs in CI with exit codes to lint OpenAPI specs and run tests. None of the evidence shows it managing or syncing actual API infrastructure or gateway configuration as declarative state from CI; it only governs API design and test artifacts. Missing for 10: declarative gateway/infrastructure config management, CI-driven sync or deploy of that config to a gateway, drift detection or reconciliation, and independent corroboration of an APIOps workflow.
